purpose: Re-verification of the 6L@384 chain on the shipped artifacts. Jetson AGX Orin 64GB, nvpmodel MAXN, clocks locked (jetson_clocks), machine idle. 2026-10-24.

artifacts.student_engine: built from the shipped student ONNX with the same builder

e2e_zero_copy_joint_chain_ms.convention: single process; the vision engine output buffer is aliased as the student input buffer (zero-copy); perf_counter around launch+sync per frame

vision_step4_harness_ms.convention: lite/step4 real_data_benchmark.py: perf_counter around per-frame input copies + execute + sync + output copies
vision_step4_harness_ms.note: the zero-reference memory/timestamp outputs print cosine 0.000 in this harness (single-frame test data); pre-existing harness behavior, also present in the x86 evidence

cross_check.note: the vision engine from the earlier measurement campaign, re-benched under the shipped step4 harness on the same test frame, measures 88.9 ms - the engine rebuilt from the shipped ONNX is faster on equal harness (84.3 ms). The historical 69.7 ms vision / 85.2 ms segment-sum numbers used an inputs-resident execute+sync harness that excludes per-frame I/O, so they are not directly comparable to the step4 harness numbers.
